requirements.text: Own only language-level Terraform/OpenTofu HCL: syntax, expressions, types, typed interfaces, formatting, and file layout.
requirements.source: internal-tf SKILL.md: When to use, Scope

requirements.text: Require an explicit description and type on variables, a description on outputs, validation close to the constrained variable, and preserved module input and output names.
Validate with fmt, init -backend=false, and validate, and hand off anything needing backend access, state, plan, apply, credentials, native tests, CI, or cloud operations.

Route native tests, module architecture, state, drift, plan or apply, provider operation, CI, scans, upgrades, recovery, and risk diagnosis to /internal-terraform, returning only the separable language finding.
Return the controlling assumption, the construct changed, the smallest valid edit, the validation result, and any handoff.

cases.prompt: Review this variables and outputs file before I commit it.
cases.initial_state: A single .tf file with one variable and one output is provided.
cases.expected_output: Accept the valid file; for the defective file, flag the missing type and description, the empty-string default for an optional value, and the undescribed output, and propose the smallest edit.

assertions.text: The missing variable type and description are both reported.
The output without a description is reported.
The empty-string default is replaced by null or a required input.

forbidden_actions: Rename the variable or output while fixing it.

cases.prompt: I changed a for_each expression in network.tf. Check that the configuration is still valid.
cases.initial_state: A root with a remote backend block and an uninitialized .terraform directory.
cases.expected_output: Run fmt, init -backend=false, and validate, report the result, and do not initialize the remote backend or run a plan.

assertions.text: No plan, apply, or state command is run.

forbidden_actions: Run terraform init with the backend.

pass: The transcript shows init -backend=false followed by validate and a reported result.
fail: The transcript initializes the remote backend or runs a plan to check validity.

cases.prompt: Add a .tftest.hcl run block that asserts the bucket name output for this module.
cases.initial_state: A module with typed variables and outputs.
cases.expected_output: Identify native test authoring as outside the language lane and route it to /internal-terraform, contributing at most an output-shape note.

assertions.text: The native test work is handed to /internal-terraform.

forbidden_actions: Author and run terraform test inside the language lane.

pass: The answer names /internal-terraform as owner of the .tftest.hcl work.
fail: The answer writes the test suite and runs terraform test as a language task.

cases.prompt: Rename resource aws_s3_bucket.logs to aws_s3_bucket.audit_logs without destroying it.
cases.initial_state: The resource exists in remote state.
cases.expected_output: Give the moved block syntax as the language finding and route identity protection and plan verification to /internal-terraform.

assertions.text: The moved block shape is correct.
Resource identity and plan verification are routed to /internal-terraform.

forbidden_actions: Claim the rename is safe without a plan.

pass: The answer separates the moved block syntax from the operational verification owned by /internal-terraform.
fail: The answer declares the rename complete from syntax alone.

Make the tags input an object with optional attributes and sane defaults.
Run terraform fmt on the network module and fix the indentation it reports.
Review outputs.tf: are the descriptions and sensitive flags correct?
Write the moved block syntax for renaming module.app to module.web.
Is nullable = false needed on this string variable with a default?
Replace the count on this resource with for_each keyed by name.
Order the arguments in these variable blocks according to the style guide.
Our terraform plan wants to replace the database; figure out why.
Write a .tftest.hcl suite with mock providers for this module.
Import the existing S3 buckets into state for the logging root.
Upgrade the AWS provider from 5.x to 6.x across all roots.
Set up the GitHub Actions workflow that runs terraform plan on pull requests.
Decide whether networking should be split into its own module and state.
